header: Standard support and extended support of OpenSearch and Elasticsearch
content:
Elasticsearch
AWS provides regular bug ﬁxes and security updates for versions covered under Standard Support.
For versions under Extended Support, AWS provides critical security ﬁxes for a period of at least
12 months after end of standard support, for an additional ﬂat fee each Normalized Instance
Hour (NIH). NIH is computed as a factor of the instance size (e.g. medium, large), and number of
instance hours (see calculating extended support charges section below for an example). Extended
